why: NOTES-FROM-PLANNING.md entry 354: phone photographs of GroupLab sheets shot with .22 LR at 50 yd, each with its 25 holes marked by eye from the picture, one a bull, sheet inches from the top left. Each hole was looked at on a crop of the photograph and placed at its centre. The photographs carry no metadata; the phone's focal length is given here, as the camera recorded it.

sheets.what: The 5x5 load development letter sheet, stapled crinkled to corrugated plastic, its top corners torn and its bottom edge lifted. Bull 23's hole touches the marker below it.
